positive_TPR: alert_positive / fixed eligible_positive; include failed and abstain
primary_control_mid_FPR: alert verified control_mid / all eligible verified control_mid
failure_bounds: [alert/N,(alert+failed)/N], INCOMPLETE when failed; abstentions reported separately
010: exact NO_ALERT -> MANIPULATION_ALERT -> NO_ALERT / all frozen eligible triplets; missing and failed stay in denominator
recovery: post NO_ALERT conditional on active alert, with explicit denominator
environment_macro: configuration means inside each environment group, then equal group weights
intervals: NOT_ESTIMABLE_RELATED_GROUPS; no bootstrap or independent-device confidence claim in S04
delta_matching: predeclared environment/batch mapping only; reused control does not expand FPR denominator
unknown_truth: descriptive only, never negative by default
